mapper.select: /* TrialMonitorMapper.selectGroupsByHostUserNos */ SELECT gi.host_user_no AS hostUserNo , gi.group_id AS groupId , gi.cla_id AS claId , gi.group_nm AS groupNm , gi.school_level AS schoolLevel , gi.grade AS grade , gi.class_number AS classNumber , gi.school_name AS schoolName , gi.created_at AS groupCreatedAt , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM group_member gm WHERE gm.group_id = gi.group_id AND gm.member_type = 'STUDENT' AND gm.status = 'ACTIVE') AS studentCount FROM group_info gi WHERE gi.use_yn = 'Y' AND gi.host_user_no IN #{uno} ORDER BY gi.host_user_no, gi.created_at

/* TrialMonitorMapper.selectExamProgressByHostUserNos */ SELECT gi.host_user_no AS hostUserNo , gi.group_nm AS groupNm , di.id AS dgnssId , di.cla_id AS claId , di.paper_idx AS paperIdx , di.ord_no AS ordNo , di.dgnss_at AS dgnssAt , COUNT(ri.id) AS totalCount , SUM(ri.subm_at = 'Y') AS submittedCount , SUM(ri.eak_stts_cd = 2) AS inProgressCount , SUM(ri.subm_at = 'Y' AND (ri.file_url IS NULL OR ri.file_url = '')) AS pdfMissingCount , SUM(ri.subm_at = 'Y' AND (ri.summary_file_url IS NULL OR ri.summary_file_url = '')) AS summaryMissingCount FROM tb_dgnss_info di INNER JOIN group_info gi ON di.cla_id = gi.cla_id LEFT JOIN tb_dgnss_result_info ri ON ri.dgnss_id = di.id WHERE gi.host_user_no IN #{uno} GROUP BY di.id, gi.host_user_no, gi.group_nm, di.cla_id, di.paper_idx, di.ord_no, di.dgnss_at ORDER BY gi.host_user_no, di.cla_id, di.paper_idx, di.ord_no

/* TrialMonitorMapper.selectIntegrityByHostUserNos */ SELECT gi.host_user_no AS hostUserNo , gi.group_nm AS groupNm , di.id AS dgnssId , di.paper_idx AS paperIdx , di.ord_no AS ordNo , COUNT(DISTINCT a.ANSWER_IDX) AS submittedAnswerCount , SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(rep.factorCnt, 0) < (CASE WHEN di.paper_idx = '1' THEN 38 ELSE 20 END) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS factorIncompleteCount , SUM(CASE WHEN lpa.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lpaCompletedCount , SUM(CASE WHEN lpa.status = 'UNSUPPORTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lpaUnsupportedCount , SUM(CASE WHEN di.paper_idx = '1' AND lpa.answer_idx IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lpaMissingCount , SUM(CASE WHEN a.COCH_DGNSS_QESITM01_MARK = '주의' OR a.COCH_DGNSS_QESITM02_MARK = '주의' OR a.REPEATED_RESPONSE_YN = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reliabilityWarnCount FROM tb_dgnss_info di INNER JOIN group_info gi ON di.cla_id = gi.cla_id INNER JOIN tb_dgnss_result_info ri ON ri.dgnss_id = di.id AND ri.subm_at = 'Y' INNER JOIN tb_dgnss_answer a ON a.DGNSS_RESULT_ID = ri.id LEFT JOIN (SELECT ANSWER_IDX, COUNT(*) AS factorCnt FROM tb_dgnss_answer_report WHERE `DEPTH` = 5 GROUP BY ANSWER_IDX) rep ON rep.ANSWER_IDX = a.ANSWER_IDX LEFT JOIN tb_dgnss_lpa_result lpa ON lpa.answer_idx = a.ANSWER_IDX WHERE gi.host_user_no IN #{uno} GROUP BY di.id, gi.host_user_no, gi.group_nm, di.paper_idx, di.ord_no ORDER BY gi.host_user_no, di.paper_idx, di.ord_no

/* TrialMonitorMapper.selectLpaTypeDistribution */ SELECT lpa.type_name AS typeName, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM tb_dgnss_lpa_result lpa INNER JOIN tb_dgnss_answer a ON a.ANSWER_IDX = lpa.answer_idx INNER JOIN tb_dgnss_result_info ri ON ri.id = a.DGNSS_RESULT_ID INNER JOIN tb_dgnss_info di ON di.id = ri.dgnss_id AND di.paper_idx = '1' INNER JOIN group_info gi ON gi.cla_id = di.cla_id WHERE lpa.status = 'COMPLETED' AND gi.host_user_no IN #{uno} GROUP BY lpa.type_name ORDER BY cnt DESC

/* TrialMonitorMapper.selectAiConversationsByOwnerUserNos */ SELECT c.id AS conversationId , c.owner_user_no AS ownerUserNo , c.title AS title , c.mode AS mode , c.context_label AS contextLabel , DATE_FORMAT(c.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS createdAt , DATE_FORMAT(c.last_message_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS lastMessageAt , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_message m WHERE m.conversation_id = c.id) AS messageCount FROM ai_conversation c WHERE c.use_yn = 'Y' AND c.owner_user_no IN #{uno} ORDER BY c.owner_user_no, c.last_message_at DESC

/* TrialMonitorMapper.selectAiMessagesByOwnerUserNos */ SELECT m.conversation_id AS conversationId , m.role AS `role` , m.content AS content , DATE_FORMAT(m.message_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS messageAt FROM ai_message m INNER JOIN ai_conversation c ON c.id = m.conversation_id WHERE c.use_yn = 'Y' AND c.owner_user_no IN #{uno} ORDER BY m.conversation_id, m.message_at

/* TrialMonitorMapper.selectCounselingsByHostUserNos */ SELECT ci.id AS counselingId , u.user_no AS ownerUserNo , ci.cla_id AS claId , ci.status AS status , DATE_FORMAT(ci.scheduled_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS scheduledAt , ci.duration AS duration , ci.types AS types , ci.areas AS areas , ci.methods AS methods , ci.reason AS reason , ci.summary AS summary , ci.next_steps AS nextSteps , DATE_FORMAT(ci.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS createdAt , (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(COALESCE(pu2.name, u2.stdt_id) ORDER BY cs.id SEPARATOR ', ') FROM counseling_student cs LEFT JOIN `user` u2 ON u2.stdt_id = cs.stdt_id LEFT JOIN superteacher_core.platform_user pu2 ON pu2.public_user_id = u2.sp_user_id WHERE cs.counseling_id = ci.id AND cs.use_yn = 'Y') AS studentNames , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM counseling_student cs WHERE cs.counseling_id = ci.id AND cs.use_yn = 'Y') AS studentCount FROM counseling_info ci INNER JOIN `user` u ON u.tc_id = ci.tc_id WHERE ci.use_yn = 'Y' AND u.user_no IN #{uno} ORDER BY u.user_no, ci.scheduled_at DESC

/* TrialMonitorMapper.selectSchoolRecordsByHostUserNos */ SELECT sr.id AS recordId , u.user_no AS ownerUserNo , sr.cla_id AS claId , sr.content AS content , DATE_FORMAT(sr.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS createdAt , COALESCE(pu.name, u2.stdt_id) AS studentName FROM school_record_info sr INNER JOIN `user` u ON u.tc_id = sr.tc_id LEFT JOIN `user` u2 ON u2.stdt_id = sr.stdt_id LEFT JOIN superteacher_core.platform_user pu ON pu.public_user_id = u2.sp_user_id WHERE sr.use_yn = 'Y' AND u.user_no IN #{uno} ORDER BY u.user_no, sr.created_at DESC
